brief: Prioritize Underhill Bluff 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-565) for pre-event attention because its advanced age of 54 years indicates a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal stress, per MG-023. If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, as outlined in MG-023. Ensure all applied de-ratings, reasons, values, and periods are recorded and that full ratings are restored only when underlying conditions are corrected and verified, in accordance with MG-021.
